messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm adding a WireGuard tunnel example to the Private/VPC installer docs for KMS/HSM connectivity. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/XXXX. Need quick review on the networking snippets and any air-gapped caveats.

chris: Saw the PR, nice. A few quick calls: call out UDP 51820 must be allowed (egress), mention MTU tuning (esp for jumbo frames), and add a note on PSK rotation policy.

sam: Agree with chris. Also recommend a split-route example so only the KMS subnet is routed over the tunnel (prevent routing customer prod traffic). Short example would help.

jen: Can we include a systemd drop-in + wg-quick unit example? Also add a minimal nftables snippet (our docs already have iptables variants, but we need parity). For air-gapped installs, add steps to pre-seed peer public keys and the wg binary in the offline bundle.

maya: Good points. I'll add: (1) wg-quick config example, (2) nftables and iptables examples, (3) systemd unit drop-in, (4) MTU note and keepalive. I'll also add a short checklist for prepopulating keys in air-gapped bundles.

chris: For MTU: recommend calculating mtu = path_mtu - 80 or start with 1420 for most cloud+onprem links. Add a note about fragmentation with UDP and TLS encapsulation (if using wireguard-over-tcp fallback).

maya: Pasting the initial snippets I'll add to the PR — feel free to suggest edits: 

```
# /etc/wireguard/wg-kms.conf
[Interface]
PrivateKey = <redacted-private-key>
Address = 10.250.100.2/32
DNS = 169.254.169.253
MTU = 1420
PostUp = ip -4 rule add from 10.250.100.2 table wgroute; ip route add default via 10.250.100.1 dev %i table wgroute
PostDown = ip -4 rule delete from 10.250.100.2 table wgroute; ip route del default via 10.250.100.1 dev %i table wgroute

[Peer]
PublicKey = <kms-peer-pubkey>
AllowedIPs = 10.250.200.0/24
Endpoint = kms.example.com:51820
PersistentKeepalive = 25
# PSK optional: PreSharedKey = <pre-shared-key>
```

maya: nftables example for NATting only KMS subnet (replace iface and nets as-needed):

```
nft add table ip redwood
nft add chain ip redwood prerouting { type filter hook prerouting priority 0 \; }
nft add chain ip redwood postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100 \; }
# masquerade outbound from wg tunnel to external if needed
nft add rule ip redwood postrouting oifname "eth0" ip saddr 10.250.100.0/24 counter masquerade
```

sam: Nice. Can we add a one-liner for split tunnel route removal if the user wants to revert? e.g. `ip rule del from 10.250.100.2 table wgroute` and `ip route flush table wgroute`.

jen: For systemd, include a simple drop-in that ensures wg-quick@wg-kms.service starts after network-online.target and before docker.service (if customer runs local containers relying on tunnel). Also document enabling the service: `systemctl enable --now wg-quick@wg-kms`.

maya: Will do. Also adding a short air-gap checklist: 
- Include wg binary + kernel module (.ko) in offline bundle if using custom kernels
- Pre-seed peer pubkeys + fingerprints in /etc/redwood/kms-wireguard/
- Add firewall rule file and post-install script to apply rules after network bring-up

chris: Minor doc nit: spell out that HSM vendors sometimes require port mappings for management plane in addition to KMS ports; recommend coordination with vendor support during migration.

maya: Added that note. Also included a short migration step for Dedicated -> Private: create tunnel on private side, test reachability to kms admin port (TCP 7443) before switching routing.

jen: LGTM from docs side. Could someone from eng-sre quick smoke this on a VM with nftables? If not, mark "needs eng-sre validation" in PR checklist.

maya: Tagging eng-sre for validation in PR and adding a checklist item. I'll push updates in ~30m.

docs-bot: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/XXXX (files changed: docs/private/wireguard-kms.md, examples/nftables-wg.md, snippets/wg-systemd.md)

sam: Quick suggestion — add a short troubleshooting table: common failures (MTU mismatch, missing UDP egress, missing kernel module) and quick checks (tcpdump on wg port, `wg show`, `ip route show table wgroute`).

maya: Good call — adding troubleshooting table. Thanks all, will ping again when PR is ready for final.
